# netbox_service_template (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/ipam/servicetemplate/):

> A service template is a reusable definition of a service, with its protocol and ports.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_service_template" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `port_mappings` (Set of String)
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
